scope: Foster Auditorium at 801 Sixth Avenue, Tuscaloosa, after the November 2010 restoration. Includes the historic auditorium, columned entry façade and attached south rooms.

originalReview.notes: The 2008 straight-on view establishes the six Ionic columns, entablature inscription, door and sash divisions, pediment and fine dentils. The November 2010 views control the restored entrance state.

references.filename: Malone Hood Plaza University of Alabama.jpg

originalReview.notes: The raking northwest view confirms the projecting pediment, lower limestone plinth, pale front cornices, masonry window rhythm and plaza approach.

references.filename: Malone Hood Plaza University of Alabama northeast view.jpg

originalReview.notes: The northeast view shows the restored central three door pairs, adjacent sash bays, sill railing and the tall stone columns in front of the red brick wall.

references.filename: Foster Auditorium Malone Hood Plaza University of Alabama.jpg

originalReview.notes: The full façade view controls the three-part massing, stepped parapet, white quoins, repeating bays and depth of the colonnade. The freestanding tower and plaza appear in context.

quallaSearch.notes: All four exact Qualla originals match original photographer uploads with first-party PD-self declarations. The current story hero matches Ttownfeen’s November 2010 photograph. The duplicate gallery record with another artist did not supply the matching bytes.
